TRADE_LICENSE.title: Trade License
TRADE_LICENSE.source: Your trade, commercial, or economic license issued by the business licensing authority (DED / Economy).
TRADE_LICENSE.details: OCR reads legal entity name, trading name, trade license number, license holder/manager name, address, email, and phone.

FACILITY_LICENSE.title: Healthcare Facility License
FACILITY_LICENSE.source: Your healthcare facility license issued by the health authority (DHA, DOH, or MOHAP).
FACILITY_LICENSE.details: OCR reads clinic/facility name, facility type, facility license number, issuing authority, and emirate.

MOHAP_ADVERTISING.title: MOHAP Healthcare Advertising Permit
MOHAP_ADVERTISING.source: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP) health advertisement permit or license for the clinic.
MOHAP_ADVERTISING.details: OCR reads the MOHAP health advertisement permit number, validity, and attaches the permit for compliance review.
